chapter: The union and the 1920s-30s band scene
title: Maxwell Davis, tenor player and arranger
summary: Howard remembers Maxwell Davis living near him and becoming a fine arranger.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Who? Maxwell Davis? Yep, he lived right down the street from me. Right up the street.
What do you remember about Maxwell?
Well, he was a good player, and a fine -- after awhile, he got to be a fine -- what do you call it.
Arranger. Yeah, he was an arranger. That's what he was. And a good one, Buddy. You should remember him.
Oh, I remember Maxwell Davis (inaudible). because he was a very talented guy. He was also doing something with --
You know, you've played with pretty near everybody around here. Everybody.
